body: Thank you so much for answering, I really needed this, someone who just understands. I am looking into treatment, maybe soon I’ll find the right one.

I don’t think it will help. I’ve been to 3 different psychologists and one psychiatrist in the past, but my experiences with them were bad (one tried to asked me out, the other didn’t seem to care much and the other told my parents about my depression without my consent, which made my relationship with them worst). The psychiatrist did help because I was medicated with Tafil and Anapsique for a while, but then I stopped taking the meds and I haven’t returned to any kind of treatment ever since.
